description: Register a website with the organization without running an audit (run_audit registers automatically, so this is only needed to set a site up ahead of time). Returns the website_id. Calling it again for the same domain returns the existing website, and a kind or scope passed again replaces the stored one. Pass kind to classify it as owned or prospect up front. On a plan with scheduled audits, a NEW site's recurring audits switch on by themselves after its first successful audit, and each of those runs costs credits: tell the user before calling this; update_website_settings with schedule "off" turns them off. The result's scheduled_audits field reports what was set.

kind.description: Classify the site: 'owned' for something the user runs and monitors, 'prospect' for a lead or competitor. Filterable in list_websites. Unclassified sites read as 'owned', so only an explicit 'prospect' makes a site show up in a prospect cleanup. Re-calling with a different value reclassifies it.

scope.description: The website's stored crawl scope, used by every later audit of it. 'discover' follows links; 'sitemap' audits only the URLs the sitemap publishes. Omit to leave an existing site's setting unchanged (a new site starts on 'discover'). Re-calling with a different value updates it.

url.description: Website URL to register, e.g. https://example.com (scheme optional).

name: add_website
title: Add a website
